# `dashboard/views/profile.ts`

## Overview

Provides view rendering functions for the user profile section of the dashboard. These functions generate HTML string output for displaying profile-related UI components, including the full profile page and a partial view for listing user credentials.

---

## Functions

### `credentialsListPartial`

Renders a partial HTML string for displaying a list of user credentials.

```ts
import { credentialsListPartial } from '...'
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `credentials` | `UserCredentialRow[]` | The list of credential records to render. |

#### Returns

`string` — An HTML string representing the credentials list partial.

#### Example

```ts
import { credentialsListPartial } from 'dashboard/views/profile'

const html = credentialsListPartial(userCredentials)
```

---

### `profilePage`

Renders the full HTML string for the user profile page, including session user details and associated credentials.

```ts
import { profilePage } from '...'
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `user` | `SessionUser` | The currently authenticated session user whose profile is being rendered. |
| `credentials` | `UserCredentialRow[]` | The list of credential records associated with the user. |

#### Returns

`string` — An HTML string representing the complete profile page.

#### Example

```ts
import { profilePage } from 'dashboard/views/profile'

const html = profilePage(sessionUser, userCredentials)
```
